title: Tax-Free Recovery Limit on Reissued Income Annuities Installments for Annuitized and IRA Contracts
content:
The tax-free part of a reissued Ashgrove Income Annuities installment is never more than the investment in the contract less the tax-free amount already recovered, and never less than zero. The investment in the contract is set as follows:

**Annuitized Ashgrove deferred annuity.** For a contract bought by annuitizing an Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity (a Deferred Fixed Annuities contract) or an Ashgrove fixed indexed annuity (a Fixed Indexed Annuities contract), the investment in the contract is the cost basis of the annuity annuitized, as shown on that annuitized contract's record.

**IRA contracts.** For any other traditional or SEP IRA contract, the investment in the contract is zero.

For an Income Annuities contract in neither situation, this rule does not apply.

The income annuity record shows which situation a contract is in: its purchase source, the annuitized contract's reference number, and its tax qualification.

**Outcomes (hypothetical reissued installment of $1,250.00, exclusion ratio 35%).**

| Contract | Investment in the contract | Already recovered | Tax-free part |
|---|---|---|---|
| Annuitized Deferred Fixed Annuities contract, cost basis $64,000.00 | $64,000.00 | $63,800.00 | $200.00 (capped at the $200.00 left) |
| Annuitized Fixed Indexed Annuities contract, cost basis $40,000.00 | $40,000.00 | $12,000.00 | $437.50 |
| SEP IRA funded by IRA transfer | Zero | $0.00 | $0.00, whole installment taxable |
